def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    orders = db["orders"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    entities = list(entity_ids)
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entities, name="product_id"))

    # --- Только информация, существующая на момент seed_time ---
    # Продажи: момент покупки <= seed_time
    items_past = order_items[
        (order_items["product_id"].isin(entities)) &
        (order_items["ts"] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()

    # Заказы, известные на момент seed_time (по моменту покупки)
    orders_known = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time].copy()
    known_order_ids = set(orders_known["order_id"])

    # Оставляем только позиции известных заказов
    items_past = items_past[items_past["order_id"].isin(known_order_ids)]

    # 1. Агрегаты за всю предшествующую историю
    if not items_past.empty:
        agg_all = items_past.groupby("product_id").agg(
            n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            n_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
            total_price=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            mean_price=("price", "mean"),
            mean_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            std_price=("price", "std"),
            std_freight=("freight_value", "std"),
            n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            min_ts=("ts", "min"),
            max_ts=("ts", "max")
        )
        features = features.join(agg_all)

    # 2. Временные признаки
    if "max_ts" in features.columns:
        features["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - features["max_ts"]).dt.days
        features["days_since_first"] = (seed_time - features["min_ts"]).dt.days
        features["active_days"] = (features["max_ts"] - features["min_ts"]).dt.days
        features = features.drop(columns=["min_ts", "max_ts"])

    # 3. Агрегаты по временным окнам
    windows = [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]
    for win in windows:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=win)
        items_win = items_past[items_past["ts"] > cutoff]
        if items_win.empty:
            features[f"win{win}_cnt_orders"] = 0
            features[f"win{win}_cnt_items"] = 0
            features[f"win{win}_sum_price"] = 0.0
            features[f"win{win}_mean_price"] = 0.0
        else:
            agg_win = items_win.groupby("product_id").agg(
                cnt_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
                cnt_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
                sum_price=("price", "sum"),
                mean_price=("price", "mean")
            ).add_prefix(f"win{win}_")
            features = features.join(agg_win)

    # Тренд: отношение продаж последних 30 дней к предыдущим 30
    c30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    c60 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60)
    recent = items_past[items_past["ts"] > c30].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
    prev = items_past[(items_past["ts"] > c60) & (items_past["ts"] <= c30)].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
    features["sales_recent_30"] = recent.reindex(features.index).fillna(0)
    features["sales_prev_30"] = prev.reindex(features.index).fillna(0)
    denom = features["sales_prev_30"].replace(0, np.nan)
    features["sales_trend_30"] = (features["sales_recent_30"] / denom).fillna(0.0)

    # 4. Признаки на основе отзывов (только отзывы, созданные до seed_time)
    if not items_past.empty and not reviews.empty:
        reviews_known = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
        order_rating = reviews_known.groupby("order_id")["review_score"].mean().rename("avg_review").reset_index()

        prod_orders = items_past[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
        prod_orders = prod_orders.merge(order_rating, on="order_id", how="left")

        rated = prod_orders[prod_orders["avg_review"].notna()]
        if not rated.empty:
            rating_agg = rated.groupby("product_id")["avg_review"].agg(
                avg_review_score="mean",
                n_reviews="count",
                pct_positive_reviews=lambda x: (x >= 4).mean() * 100
            )
            features = features.join(rating_agg)

    # 5. Платежи (только известные на момент seed_time)
    if not payments.empty and not items_past.empty:
        pay_known = payments[payments["ts"] <= seed_time]
        pay_known = pay_known[pay_known["order_id"].isin(known_order_ids)]
        pay_agg = pay_known.groupby("order_id").agg(
            pay_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
            pay_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
            n_pay_methods=("payment_type", "nunique")
        ).reset_index()
        prod_pay = items_past[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates().merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
        prod_pay_agg = prod_pay.groupby("product_id").agg(
            mean_pay_value=("pay_value", "mean"),
            mean_installments=("pay_installments", "mean"),
            mean_n_pay_methods=("n_pay_methods", "mean")
        )
        features = features.join(prod_pay_agg)

    # 6. Статусы заказов, известные на момент seed_time
    if not items_past.empty and not orders_known.empty:
        status_map = orders_known.set_index("order_id")["order_status"]
        prod_status = items_past[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates().copy()
        prod_status["order_status"] = prod_status["order_id"].map(status_map)
        delivered = prod_status[prod_status["order_status"] == "delivered"].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().rename("n_delivered_orders")
        canceled = prod_status[prod_status["order_status"].isin(["canceled", "unavailable"])].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().rename("n_canceled_orders")
        features = features.join(delivered).join(canceled)
        features["pct_delivered"] = (features["n_delivered_orders"] / features["n_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
        features = features.drop(columns=["n_delivered_orders", "n_canceled_orders"])

    # 7. Глобальные временные признаки
    features["month"] = seed_time.month
    features["quarter"] = seed_time.quarter
    features["day_of_week"] = seed_time.dayofweek
    features["year"] = seed_time.year

    # 8. Флаг наличия продаж
    if "n_orders" in features.columns:
        features["has_sales"] = (features["n_orders"].fillna(0) > 0).astype(int)
    else:
        features["has_sales"] = 0

    # 9. Заполнение пропусков и реиндексация
    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0.0)
    features.index.name = "product_id"

    return features
